senses.gloss: (contract, of דְּאִי לָא) for if not. דִּל כֵּן (joined דִּלָכֵן, דִּילָכֵן, v. דִּי II) for were it not so.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 8:1:6">Y. Yoma VIII, 44ᵈ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 7:1:2">Y. Gitt. VII, beg. 48ᶜ</cite>; a. e.—Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ bot.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:2:7">Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אכול דילכן וכ׳</he> eat, for if thou (doest) not so, I shall kill thee.
